verdict.rationale: Unit is an API-first financial platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. The evidence never mentions one. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and the 'Explore the API' and webhooks doc links do not show a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
